- problem: Process startup may accept new requests before old data-job leases or uncertainty statuses are classified; stop only halts future ticks and cannot say whether queued jobs were admitted or completed. runNow's void result cannot distinguish response loss from non-admission.

- currentBehavior: Before any query, buildSnapshot checks disabled/offline and returns null. The service interprets that null as skipped work and records reason no-data; there is no distinction between configuration-disabled, connection-offline, and a stale but usable read projection.
- problem: A boolean-like null result loses the reason needed for capability policy, UI status, scheduler retry, and audit. It also cannot tell a caller whether serving the last known projection is safe as a stale read or forbidden for a live capture.
- preservedBehavior:
  - Preserve the current guarantee that offline/disabled accounts do not produce zero-value snapshots.

### MAP-473BE32758

- mapping source: [services/uta/src/domain/trading/snapshot/builder.ts:20-31](../../../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/snapshot/builder.ts#L20-L31)
- symbol: buildSnapshot synchronization and account queries
- id: MAP-473BE32758
- sourceEvidence:
  - services/uta/src/domain/trading/snapshot/builder.ts:20-31: buildSnapshot best-effort awaits uta.sync, reads pending order IDs from uta.git, then Promise.all fetches account, positions, and filtered orders: Snapshot creation first invokes uta.sync and suppresses every sync rejection. It derives pending IDs from local Git, then concurrently calls live getAccount/getPositions/getOrders. A successful later query can therefore be paired with an unobserved failed sync and with local intent that is not the broker observation.
- currentBehavior: Snapshot creation first invokes uta.sync and suppresses every sync rejection. It derives pending IDs from local Git, then concurrently calls live getAccount/getPositions/getOrders. A successful later query can therefore be paired with an unobserved failed sync and with local intent that is not the broker observation.
- problem: The builder has hidden network and Git side effects, no dispatch/observation identity, no read version fence, and no typed failure. Suppressing sync failure can make order state look current when it is not; concurrent calls have no common as-of boundary.
- preservedBehavior:
  - Retain the practical reason for pre-snapshot synchronization: stale submitted orders must eventually be reconciled before a fresh view is claimed.
  - Remove best-effort suppression and local Git pending IDs as broker truth; the reconciliation worker now makes freshness visible and durable.
- openQuestions: —

  - services/uta/src/domain/trading/snapshot/scheduler.ts:1-18: 调度器当前把 SnapshotService.takeAllSnapshots("scheduled") 直接作为 Pump 的 tick 回调，并把回调异常记录后吞掉；该边界只有进程内事件，没有 durable data-request cursor、source sequence 或可恢复的请求身份
- currentBehavior: 调度器当前把 SnapshotService.takeAllSnapshots("scheduled") 直接作为 Pump 的 tick 回调，并把回调异常记录后吞掉；该边界只有进程内事件，没有 durable data-request cursor、source sequence 或可恢复的请求身份。
- problem: After a committed source operation, a fire-and-forget hook or the next cron tick cannot be used to infer that a snapshot request was durably admitted. Process exit between the source commit and callback loses the request; a provider read with unknown outcome must not be treated as an ordinary schedule failure or blindly retried.
- preservedBehavior:
  - 继续支持 scheduled trigger 及既有手动/后置触发语义，但后置触发改由 committed event 关联，不靠 timing。
  - 保持每个账户独立处理；一个 scope 的失败不能抹掉其他 scope 的已提交事实。
  - 保持 EventLog 作为可读观测/审计输出，不能让其失败回滚交易 commit。
- openQuestions:
  - 生产历史 journal/legacy files 的 schema/version、每个 scope 的 record identity、revision/sequence 单调性与缺口、以及已持久化 migration/subscriber cursor 仍需实施前实际数据盘点；当前 source 仅有进程内 Pump，不能回答该事实。

- currentBehavior: createSnapshotScheduler 为 Pump 提供 onTick，tick 时一次性调用 takeAllSnapshots("scheduled")；Pump 的 serial 选项只在本进程内避免重入，无法表示每个 AccountScope 的 lease 或跨进程恢复。
- problem: 一次全账户 fan-out 把 scope 边界、并发预算和提交顺序隐藏掉；重启/多实例会重复扫描，交易触发请求可能与 scheduled 批次互相丢弃或覆盖。
- preservedBehavior:
  - 保持 scheduled trigger 的周期性意图及每账户独立失败隔离。
  - 保持同一进程内不并行冲突快照的结果，但把 serial 约束提升为 durable per-scope lease。
  - 保持手动和交易提交请求的优先级高于可选 telemetry。

- currentBehavior: SnapshotService 接口把采集、批量调度、查询、删除混在一起，方法返回 Promise&lt;UTASnapshot|null&gt; 或 Promise&lt;boolean&gt;，没有 query checkpoint、scope 或 durable receipt。
- problem: The single interface hides distinct data boundaries: capture admission needs an accepted data-job receipt and selected persistence boundary, query only reads a projection, and retention cannot erase recorded observations; null/bool cannot express partial/unavailable/recovery outcomes.
- preservedBehavior:
  - 保留 manual/scheduled/post-push/post-reject 的调用意图，通过 Cause 映射而非删掉 trigger。
  - 保留查询 limit/range 能力，但改成 typed Instant/sequence bounds。
  - 保留可授权删除历史读模型的需求，禁止其越权为 journal delete。
